1.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_008_000
1.description: Hmmm? I'm sort of busy here, um, looking at the, uh...the grass. It's quite green, I've noticed, and...ugh, you're gonna ask me to clear the area, aren't you?

2.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_008_005
2.description: Oh well all right then, let's get this over with.

3.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_008_010
3.description: Oh, that's a relief. I am <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> in the mood to clear an entire ridge right now. Or ever, really.

4.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_008_000
4.description: Clear the ridge to build a cropland?

7.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_009_000
7.description: Look at me, jumping with excitement. A fault in the programming, to be sure. Anyway, are you happy now? There's the cropland. I've even got some seeds for you to sow. Once they've been planted, make sure to water them.

8.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_009_005
8.description: Oh─if you have any questions, I suppose I can answer them.

9.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_009_000
9.description: You can now plant seeds in empty plots by using the Sow mode, which may be enabled by selecting the appropriate icon from the mode section of the islekeep's index.

11.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_009_010
11.description: You can now water crops by using the Water mode, which may be enabled by selecting the appropriate icon from the mode section of the islekeep's index.

15.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_010_000
15.description: Still haven't planted the seeds? That's fine by me, I'm certainly not in any rush.

16.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_010_000
16.description: Enable the Sow mode from the islekeep's index, select the island pumpkin seeds, and access an empty plot to begin planting.

17.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_011_000
17.description: Well, now that you've planted the seeds, naturally you need to water them, right? This is real basic stuff.

18.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_011_000
18.description: You may water a plot that has been sown with seeds by accessing it with the Water mode enabled.

19.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_012_000
19.description: Shhh... Can you hear that? The sound of burgeoning life, budding in the soil? Me neither, but I thought I'd ask. Anyway, you're welcome to plant more seeds here whenever you like.

20.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_012_000
20.description: Crops require time and water to flourish into produce. Bereft of moisture, they will cease to grow. Crops will be considered watered after it has rained.

21.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_012_005
21.description: You may harvest the produce yielded by fully developed crops with the Gather mode, or alternatively dispose of undesired crops with the Cull mode.

25.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_100_005
25.description: What will you do?<hex:02100103>Cropland expansion complete in: <hex:022003E80203> <hex:020812E4E80202FF05686F7572FF06686F75727303>.

33.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_200_000
33.description: You're giving me that look. That look where you want me to do something. Let me guess, you want more space for crops? <hex:021A020203>Fine<hex:021A020103>, I'll do it, but only because I have to.

34.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_200_005
34.description: There you are, an expanded cropland. More plots for more crops. Surely you'll never need more space than this, right? Please tell me I'm right.

35.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_300_000
35.description: Really? Again? I swear, this is the <hex:021A020203>last<hex:021A020103> time I'm doing this. Unless you tell me to do it again, in which case I guess I'll do it again. But watch yourself, or I'll put you on my bad list right next to that abominable furball!

36.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_300_005
36.description: Well, I hope you don't regret making the cropland larger, because there's no going back now. It's reached a size where you could build another one inside of it. That is <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> a suggestion, by the way.

37.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_300_010
37.description: With the size the cropland's become, I'm sure even you are loath to deal with it. As am I. But, as long as you pay me─and my team─I suppose we can help you look after it. We'll need a set of mammet-sized cropworker's tools to do so, though.

38.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_300_015
38.description: Here, I'll give you the recipe. Just let me know when you've finished crafting the tools.

39.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_300_020
39.description: Wait, I feel like there was something else... Oh, right! I've decided to start selling the seeds I've collected. You're welcome to purchase them, if you like.

40.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_300_025
40.description: Anyway, I'll be here if you need me.

41.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_300_000
41.description: The mammet-sized cropworker's tools recipe has been added to the sanctuary crafting log. Deliver this set of tools to the produce producer once it has been crafted.

42.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_300_005
42.description: The produce producer's shop is now available. Seeds that cannot be gathered in the wild may be purchased in exchange for seafarer's cowries.

43.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_400_000
43.description: Spend <hex:022206E802FF022C03> seafarer's cowries to expand the cropland? <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>This will take roughly <hex:022003E80303> hours, but the cropland will remain accessible.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

44.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_Q3_400_000
44.description: Expand the cropland! Make it bigger. Make it better.

46.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_400_000
46.description: Know that my team and I will need plenty of time, and at least <hex:022206E802FF022C03> seafarer's cowries.

47.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_400_005
47.description: No point in postponing the inevitable. We'll get started. Come back in a bit.

48.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_400_010
48.description: Oh my, what a shame. What a darn shame. You don't have enough cowries! I guess we can't do our jobs. Come back when you have at least <hex:022206E802FF022C03> seafarer's cowries.

49.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_400_015
49.description: Not right now? So that means later? Well, isn't that just lovely.

50.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_500_000
50.description: Hmmm? What? Oh yes, yes we're working quite hard. Nearly finished with the expansion, we are. We were going to leave the last bit until tomorrow, but now that you're here, we might as well work ourselves to the bone.

51.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_600_000
51.description: Oh, you wouldn't be interested in the gardening services. I'm sure you love tending to crops yourself. But, if you would for some reason deny yourself of such an enriching experience, my team and I can─if we must─help you look after the crops.

52.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_600_005
52.description: That said, the cropland has hardly reached a size you're unable to handle. And I hardly have a so-called team. Therefore, I can hardly offer such services at this time.

53.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_600_010
53.description: Well, we could, if you gave us the means to do so. Which you have not. If you really want our help, I suggest you craft a set of mammet-sized cropworker's tools.

54.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_600_015
54.description: And is that a set of mammet-sized cropworker's tools I see there? You've come prepared, but know this: just because you have the tools, it doesn't mean you need to use them. And that is absolutely <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> a phrase I learned to avoid doing work.

55.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_600_020
55.description: When you consider that you have to actually pay us for our labor, does it really seem worth it in the end? I mean, we certainly can't take care of crops as well as you can with our tiny mammet hands. Hells, we could probably fit in an empty plot if you stuck us in one.

56.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_SYSTEM_600_000
56.description: You may now entrust the produce producer and its team of mammets to take care of crops in the cropland.

58.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_700_000
58.description: Say, do you ever feel like you're being watched? I can't seem to shake the sensation, lately. I'm beginning to wonder if I'm in need of a recalibration...

60.name: TEXT_CTSMJICROPLAND_00804_TAGAYASU_800_000
60.description: Oh, a visitor. Must be nice, getting to travel and all. I just stand around here all day, watching the grass grow. You're welcome to join me, if you like.
